notes.title: Ancient Era Update ver.2.0.2🔥
notes.content:
Hey Heroes!

We just released ver.2.0.2 of Ancient Era!

Fixes: 
- Main Menu bugs (LIV camera error and the double click error)
- VR Comic (one miss ordered scene)
- Keyboard control for controller menu buttons.  (temporary solution for people who have trouble with pressing menu buttons.) 
  By pressing [→] key, you can flip pages of the tutorial.
  By holding [↑] for one second, you can quit the tutorial scene and the battle stage. 
 
We are eagerly adding a lot of suggestions given by our reviewers. If you'd like to suggest more ideas, please don't hesitate to do so!

[b]Discord Link: https://discord.gg/nKFUxQY[/b]

We will keep updating, so stay tuned!

Cheers!

notes.title: UPDATE v0.1.1⚡️
notes.content:
Hey Ninjas!

Our first update for Be The Hero has been released!
IMPORTANT NOTE: You have to update to DirectX 11 or higher to play BE THE HERO.

Fixes: 
- Score attack mode added
- Added visual marker for players to head towards after defeating a round of enemies
- Option to skip comic 
- Option to return to the main screen after ending credits
- "Harakiri" to reset player position.

We are also currently working to provide the following: 
- More enemies, and improved AI 
- Mini map on UI
- New city map
- New weapons
- Adjustments on player's attacks and movement 

We are eagerly adding a lot of suggestions given by our reviewers.  If you'd like to suggest more ideas, please don't hesitate to do so!

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey folks!  


Thank you so much for lots of helpful feedback based on our [url=https://expvr.itch.io/bethehero] Prototype![/url] We heard you loud and clear, and we axed the climbing-with-trigger action. It won't be part of the official game.

Our goal is to make BE THE HERO available for Early Access in late Spring via Steam.

If you'd like to chat with us directly, feel free to join us at our [url=https://discord.gg/nKFUxQY] Discord![/url]

We also have an [url=https://www.instagram.com/expvr/]instagram[/url] if you want to see what we look like in our messy office 😀

Happy Gaming, Heroes!
